#load library
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

#clear the environment
rm(list=ls()) 

# set working directory to project root for reproducibility
setwd(".")

load("secondary_genes/Exp_data_secondary_CpG.RData")
secondary_results <- read_excel("secondary_genes/lung_genes_secondary_results.xlsx")

alpha = 0.05
```

# Select the top 5 CpG sites (which have the smallest unadjusted p-values)
```{r}
CpG <- as.matrix(secondary_results[c(1:5),1])

n=nrow(CpG)
```

# calculate 95% Neymanian interval for top 5 secondary CpG sites 
```{r}
#find two-tailed t critical values for 95% CI
t <- qt(p=.05/2, df=16, lower.tail=FALSE)

d_i <- list()
s_d <- matrix(nrow=5, ncol=1)
d_bar <- matrix(nrow=5, ncol=1)
CI <- matrix(nrow=5, ncol=2)

for(h in 1:n){ #h represents the number of cpg column values
   mn <- which(colnames(final_secondary_CpG)==CpG[h,1]) #find the column number mn for the desired CpG in the final secondary Cpg dataset
   table <- final_secondary_CpG %>% select(2,3,mn) #make a table that only has the selected CpG
   table_wide <- table %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Exposure, values_from = as.character(CpG[h,1])) # make the table wider
   d_i[h]<- table_wide[,3]-table_wide[,2] #values of ozone treatment minus that of clean air
   s_d[h,1]<-sd(d_i[[h]]) #standard deviation of differences 
   d_bar[h,1] <-sum(d_i[[h]])/17 #sample mean of differences
   CI[h,1] <-  d_bar[h,1] - t*s_d[h,1]/sqrt(17)   #lower bound stored here
   CI[h,2] <-  d_bar[h,1] + t*s_d[h,1]/sqrt(17)   #upper bound stored here
}

CI_neyman_secondary <- CpG %>% cbind(CI) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename(lower_bound=V2, upper_bound=V3) %>% mutate(lower_bound=as.numeric(lower_bound)) %>% mutate(upper_bound=as.numeric(upper_bound)) 

write_xlsx(CI_neyman_secondary,"secondary_genes/top5_95CI_secondary.xlsx")

#option rounding: CI_neyman_secondary[1:9, 2:3] <- round(CI_neyman_secondary[1:9, 2:3], digits = 4)
```
